name: Swish Alley: Arcade Basketball
subtitle: Flick to shoot, 3D hoop, duel
promo: Stand iPhone Duo half open and the hoop rises from the fold. Flick to shoot, get on fire, and beat your best in 60 seconds. The duel is free forever, with no ads.
description:
Swish Alley is arcade basketball you play with one flick. Swipe the ball up toward the hoop: the speed of your flick sets the power, its direction sets the aim. Make as many baskets as you can in 60 seconds.

BUILT FOR iPHONE DUO
Stand iPhone Duo half open, like a tiny laptop. The upright half becomes the backboard, the lower half the floor with your ball rack, and the rim hangs right above the fold. Swish Alley reads the live hinge angle and the real position of the fold, so the backboard stands upright and the floor lies flat whether the hinge is at 90, 110 or 130 degrees, and the ball's arc follows the real shape of the phone. Fold it while you play and the court follows smoothly.

A HOOP THAT POPS OUT
Turn on head tracking and the front camera follows where your eyes are. The hoop is drawn from your point of view, so it seems to stand out of the phone, and you can lean to look around the backboard. It's optional: the game plays exactly the same with it off.

ARCADE FEEL
A satisfying swish through the net, a rattle on the rim, a thump off the backboard and a haptic tap for every bounce. Three in a row and you're on fire: baskets are worth 3 until you miss, six in a row and you're unstoppable. In the last 10 seconds every basket counts double and the hoop starts to glide. One more run? Always one more run.

FACE-TO-FACE DUEL, FREE
Open iPhone Duo flat between two players, one half each, with the fold as the centre line. Race each other at the same time or take turns. On any other iPhone or iPad the screen splits down the middle.

MODES
Classic 60 seconds, Overtime (every basket adds time), Drift (the hoop never stops), the duel (race or turns) and practice are all free. Golden balls bring bonuses: a bigger hoop or double points.

PLAYS EVERYWHERE
On iPhone, iPad and the folded iPhone Duo the screen becomes a window into a neon arcade lane, with the same physics and optional head tracking.

WARM RETRO ARCADE
An original neon-lit gym with warm cabinet wood and original instrumental music played by a synthesizer on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking, works offline.

SWISH ALLEY PRO
One payment, no subscription: three more arenas, four more balls and Wild Toss, where you throw watermelons, rubber ducks, toasters and pumpkins (miss, and they splat). Every mode stays free forever.
